theorems.statement: ∀ {X : Type} [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (d : ℝ) (s : Set X) (r ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < r → ε ≠ 0 → μH[d] s ≠ ∞ → ∃ t : ℕ → Set X, s ⊆ ⋃ n, t n ∧ (∀ n, Metric.ediam (t n) ≤ r) ∧ ∑' n, ⨆ _ : (t n).Nonempty, Metric.ediam (t n) ^ d ≤ μH[d] s + ε
